title: Cyberpunk Spider Ritual
description: Two women in dark corsets perform a ritual with lit candles on a wet cyberpunk street at night. A giant mechanical spider with glowing orange eyes looms over them amidst neon signs and spiderwebs.
prompt: Two women kneeling on a rainy cyberpunk street at night, one blonde holding a candle and the other with dark hair, both wearing ornate dark corsets with spider tattoos, performing a ritual surrounded by lit candles and black feathers, a massive biomechanical spider with glowing orange eyes and metallic legs towering above them, neon signs in the background including one that reads STASIS PROTOCOL, spiderwebs and dark atmosphere, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting
